selection: An explicit saved job and its own verified preview binding; no globally newest project lookup.
supported_recipe: Pinned authored_habitat_equipment_plan_v1 meshes/materials, preview_hinged_doors_v2 and explicit paired_airlock_door_sequence_v1 policy, with bounded authored geometry eligibility rather than a single Mars fixture digest. Paired airlock doors use explicit authored_pressure_hatch_geometry_v1, with complete per-part collider ownership and source-preserving structural mesh cutouts; ordinary doors retain the existing slab policy. An explicitly requested greenhouse uses authored_controlled_greenhouse_v1: one6..12m by8..12m,4m-high crop room, four hydroponic beds and one reservoir, a curved daylight aperture, and default40% louver pose. Preview shade and plant selection are session-local; exported geometry preserves default40% and illustrative readings, with no consumer shade runtime. Room monitors use sourced_mars_reference_v1 and authored_room_monitor_v1: NASA planet reference facts, explicitly dated MEDA archive observations, authored lab/EVA/habitat placeholders, and actual local door states with no pressure simulation. Four small wall monitors are added only where existing clearances permit. Export embeds screen textures and source/date data plus initial closed-door snapshots; it does not supply a consumer monitor-update runtime. The crop screen is moved forward within its unchanged reservoir bounds to clear the rear irrigation riser.
validation_scope: No exact geometry allowlist. A bounded authored habitat profile independently recompiles the bound blueprint, verifies supported roles/topology/dimensions and unambiguous structural room ownership. Eligibility is only permission to attempt the pinned builder/importer; readiness requires all actual checks.

input.job_dir: Existing immediate saved research job under this installation
input.destination: New export directory outside protected saved world/research/preview directories
input.preview_binding: Optional exact manifest_path and manifest_sha256 for the selected job's already-open current preview
input.dependencies: Optional explicit local runtime paths; every dependency must match the tested digest and byte count

failure_after_output_creation: No ready manifest; EXPORT-INCOMPLETE.json records held status. Partial output is retained. Existing files and source folders are never overwritten or removed.
resource_behavior: CPU Canvas and Three exporter/importer only. No browser, WebGL, GPU/model job, research rerun, network fetch or dependency download. The native button runs the API in an owned background worker and reports the created folder.
